## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `POST /_actions/getWebSession/` — Initiate a web session.
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Generate an IT using RPC.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /_content/pagefind/{pagefindId}` — Retrieve content for pagefind.
- `GET /api/v1/summary` — Get a summary of the API status.
- `GET /channels/api/v2/client/{clientId}/translations/4/nl-informal.json` — Retrieve a specific translation file.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /api/stats/qoe` — Report quality of experience statistics.
- `POST /structure-collection` — Write structured data to the collection.

### Config (2)
- `GET /__manifest` — Get the application manifest.
- `POST /channels/api/v2/client/{clientId}/configs` — Update client configuration.

This skill provides access to Replicate's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency
